aaa_enabled.summary: Configure centralized authentication (RADIUS, TACACS+, or LDAP/AD) in Sangfor Web Console.
aaa_enabled.notes: Configure remote LDAP or RADIUS servers under System > Admin Accounts > Auth Server in Sangfor NGAF Web Console.

secure_vty_transport.summary: Disable HTTP management and restrict SSH access.
secure_vty_transport.notes: Configure administration protocols under System > Admin Accounts > Login Security in Sangfor NGAF Web Console.

vty_idle_timeout.notes: Modify session timeout under System > Admin Accounts > Login Security > Session Timeout in Sangfor NGAF Web Console.

enable_secret_encrypted.summary: Ensure administrative account passwords are encrypted.
enable_secret_encrypted.notes: Sangfor local administrative passwords are automatically hashed in the internal system database.

no_default_snmp_community.notes: Modify SNMP community settings under System > SNMP Settings in Sangfor NGAF Web Console.

http_server_disabled.notes: Go to Network > Interfaces, edit management interface and uncheck HTTP Management.

ssh_version_2.notes: SSH settings are configured under System > Admin Accounts > Login Security > SSH Console Access in Sangfor NGAF Web Console.

logging_enabled.notes: Go to System > Logging Options > Log Server Settings to specify remote syslog server destinations.

management_acl.summary: Restrict Web Management Console and SSH access to trusted IP hosts.
management_acl.notes: Go to System > Admin Accounts > Login Security > IP Access Controls in Sangfor NGAF Web Console.

login_banner.notes: Go to System > Admin Accounts > Login Security > Login Message to set custom warning disclaimer banner.

password_min_length.notes: Configure password complexity rules under System > Admin Accounts > Login Security > Password Policy.

ntp_configured.notes: Go to System > General Settings > Time Settings to enable and specify NTP servers.

no_write_snmp_community.notes: Ensure SNMP communities are restricted to read-only under System > SNMP Settings.
